name: source-viewer
description: High-performance source code viewer and font inspector extension for Chromium and Firefox browsers, offering developer-grade syntax highlighting, formatting, structural search, and comprehensive typography diagnostics in a distraction-free environment.
overview: Source Viewer automatically detects minified or unformatted documents, formats them seamlessly with js-beautify, applies CodeMirror 6 syntax trees, and renders rich typography previews for web fonts.
